newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. stock index futures higher, near highs.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. stock index futures higher, near highs.

text.p: Feb 28 - Most U.S. stock index futures were moderately higher, near highs late. March S&P 500s gained ground after T-bond futures managed to close higher, on pre-weekend positioning after a week of topsy-turvy swings, and at monthend as funds rebalanced portfolios, traders said. Some said a rise above pivot at 797.30 could bring rise toward resistance at 798.50. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
